title: Yesterday at the Barn
content: Yesterday I was down at the barn painting a goat and a sheep. It wasn't a sketchbook page this time, but rather full size profiles painted in acrylic on plywood. Luckily I had Sofie to advise me.The farmer, Lenny, asked me to help him with a farm-to-table display that he's setting up for theCountry Living Fairstarting today at the Rhinebeck Fairgrounds.
